title: Hal Saflieni Hypogeum Oracle Room tuned to 111 Hz

tellings.quote: And this place is precision tuned to 111 hertz.

plain: The Hal Saflieni Hypogeum, an ancient underground complex carved into rock in Malta, has a chamber called the Oracle Room that is "precision tuned to 111 hertz," a deep sound frequency, according to a guest named Jay Anderson. Anderson tells this as someone who has been there, and if it is true it would mean the ancient builders shaped the room on purpose to make sound resonate in it.
